notes.title: Honor Cry: Aftermath - Price Reduction and New Game Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,
Our RPG experience Honor Cry: Aftermath is getting a new lower price ($1.99 once it takes effect) and a new game patch to improve the game itself!

Changes:
- Increased Item Durability 15-30% so that items don't break so fast.
- Made the first few screens a bit easier in terms of enemies so you don't get ambushed by a vastly superior enemy right as you're starting out.
- Made random encounters about 5% less frequent.
- Streamlined combat so that if there's only 1 enemy, you don't have to click on their name every time.
- Made hit chances a bit higher, about 4%.
- Made the main quest in the second swamp area a bit easier by giving the player a hint where to find the Remove Curse scroll, and giving it to them possibly if they fail in the Gamemaster game 3 or more times.

Comments welcomed. Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Dev Diary #4 -- Update!
notes.content:
Hello Racing Fans,

Yes, the game is still going full speed ahead. We've been hard at work testing and re-testing. The pre-race setup screens are pretty much done now for the full race display experience, and are intuitive and look good!

As a player, you start out with the pre-qualifying day, and with the results, you can use that to help plan out your strategy.

Preliminary screens have been completed, such as this pre-qualifying screen for example:

[url=https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1_G5Wt5Dbq3t1wwW6M6SpgUHwTM82bPv8]https://drive.google.com/uc?id=1_G5Wt5Dbq3t1wwW6M6SpgUHwTM82bPv8[/url]

More screens coming soon!

Derek

notes.title: Builds: Change Notes (Current 0.91)
notes.content:
0.91 build:
-- FIX: Corrected an issue where repairing the second car in your garage wasn't charging the cost correctly.
-- FIX: Fixed an issue where sometimes saved games weren't being deleted properly.
-- TWEAK: Made repairing a little cheaper and more effective, as sometimes if had little success early on, you would be broke quickly no matter what you did just from repairing your car.
-- TWEAK: Adjusted the daily random office expenses to be a little less than before.
-- TWEAK: Added 10 more possible random events.
-- NEW: Removed the default Windows dialogue boxes for pretty much all of the info popups and replaced them with new, more attractive custom message boxes.

0.90 build:. 
-- FIX: Corrected an issue where games wouldn't save correctly past the first slot.
-- TWEAK: Adjusted the R&D algorhythm to build slightly better cars in terms of stats.
-- FIX: Fixed an occasional crash issue when simming races if you have 4 drivers on your team.
